blind.description: A stylized wooden three-tier shelving unit with curiosities displayed on all shelves and the top surface. The items include purple and green crystal mineral clusters, horned animal skulls, small treasure chests, scrolls with gold caps, a brass armillary sphere, a scrying crystal ball on a tripod stand, and a bronze humanoid face mask. The wood has a rich brown hand-painted look with carved corner posts and feet. All meshes and surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a fantasy/RPG prop art style.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top panel featuring a row of four objects: a jagged purple crystal cluster, a horned animal skull slightly overhanging the front edge, a dark metal-trimmed chest, and a cluster of green crystal points.
blind.height_vs_figure: Around 70% of the figure's height (about 4 ft tall) and roughly 3.5 ft wide.
